name: MMDemo MetaModule Coverage Evidence Contract
purpose: bind synthetic operational/demo evidence to canonical or unresolved MetaModule catalog entries without creating semantic identity or canonical authority

statusModel.EXERCISED: explicit evidence satisfies the current demo coverage rule
statusModel.PARTIAL: explicit evidence exists but the named semantics are not fully represented
statusModel.NOT_YET_EXERCISED: current demo contains no sufficient explicit evidence
statusModel.UNRESOLVED_ID: identity axis itself is unresolved and must not be guessed

evidenceRules: Business Universal EXERCISED requires an exact graph entity.type match
Platform/GUI evidence requires explicit implementation/runtime evidence and is never inferred from name similarity
Composition labels with unresolved 1.5 identity remain display labels even when demo behavior exercises the named capability
Strategy and Everyday grouping abstractions are NOT_EVENT_OWNER and coverage applies only to member labels/identities
Everyday semantics are not inferred from superficially similar business records
coverage evidence never promotes mmdemo.* data into canonical evidence
PARTIAL and NOT_YET_EXERCISED are useful final-version gaps, not silent failures

generation.rule: snapshot must be deterministically regenerated from catalog + graph + company data
